title: Art Education: Cultivating Creativity in Classrooms and Communities
what_it_is: Art Education: Cultivating Creativity in Classrooms and Communities

sections.label: Creativity beyond arts, skills ranking
sections.summary: About 73% recognised creativity was not limited to the arts, and creative thinking ranked in the top 10 skills in 2012, 2017 and 2022.

sentences.speaker: Ms Usha Chandradas (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: About three quarters or 73% recognised that creativity was not limited just to the arts.

sentences.speaker: Ms Usha Chandradas (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: According to Singapore's 2023/2024 Skills Demand for the Future Economy Report, creative thinking and the ability to generate new and innovative ideas ranks as one of the skills that has consistently been in the top 10 list in 2012, 2017 and 2022 .

sections.label: Drama in primary curriculum, student beliefs
sections.summary: MOE clarified drama is not part of the primary school curriculum beyond lower primary levels, and less than half of students believe they can produce good stories or invent new things.

sentences.speaker: Ms Usha Chandradas (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: In response to a Parliamentary Question (PQ) that I filed earlier this year, MOE clarified that drama is not part of the primary school curriculum beyond lower primary levels.

sentences.speaker: Ms Usha Chandradas (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: In the press release by MOE that I referred to earlier, I noted that less than half of our students believe that they can produce good stories or invent new things!

sections.label: Advocating concerted culture and arts education
sections.summary: The speaker advocates for culture and arts education on a more concerted and systematic basis, in line with the UNESCO framework's recommendation against siloed planning and implementation.

sentences.speaker: Ms Usha Chandradas (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Today, I would like to advocate for it to take place on a more concerted and systematic basis and this would be in line with the recommendation in the UNESCO framework that I referred to earlier and that framework says that the planning and implementation of culture and arts education should not be something that is siloed.

sections.label: Art and music teacher resignation rates
sections.summary: MOE clarified art and music teacher resignation rates were comparable to the overall teaching workforce at around 2% to 3% per year over the past five years, though arts teachers report feeling overworked and short of support.

sentences.speaker: Ms Usha Chandradas (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: In replying to my PQ filed earlier this year, MOE has clarified that "the resignation rate of art and music teachers has been comparable to that of the overall teaching workforce, at around 2% to 3% per year over the past five years." Nonetheless, I am informed by arts teachers on the ground, that many still feel overworked and feel as though there is a shortage of support in the delivery of arts education.

sections.label: NAC Artist-In-School Scheme praised
sections.summary: Teachers the speaker spoke to cited the National Arts Council's Artist-In-School Scheme as something that has helped them tremendously.

sentences.speaker: Ms Usha Chandradas (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Teachers I have spoken to have cited the National Arts Council's (NAC's) Artist-In-School Scheme, or AISS, as something which has helped them tremendously.

sections.label: Paperwork and engaging former arts teachers
sections.summary: The speaker says the process can be quite paperwork-heavy and urges MOE to consider engaging more former arts teachers to return part-time or ad hoc.

sentences.speaker: Ms Usha Chandradas (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: At the moment, I understand that it can be quite paperwork-heavy.

sentences.speaker: Ms Usha Chandradas (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: I would also like to urge MOE to consider whether more former arts teachers can be engaged to return to teaching on a part-time or ad hoc basis.

sections.label: Wall text for loaned objects
sections.summary: The speaker suggests mandatory detailed wall text for national collection objects on loan, especially in Government buildings.

sentences.speaker: Ms Usha Chandradas (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: In response to a PQ I filed last year, MCCY informed us that objects from the national collection on loan to non-museum entities. such as the Istana and Ministries, are only "minimally" required to "display a label text showing the title of the object, its artist, if applicable, its donor, if applicable, and a credit line to acknowledge the museum which manages the object on behalf of the National Heritage Board." To this end, I would like to suggest that it be mandatory for more detailed wall text explaining the artworks and objects on display, to be put up together with the works.

sentences.speaker: Ms Usha Chandradas (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: At the very least, this should be the case when such works are displayed in Government buildings.

sections.label: Samsui Woman mural and statues
sections.summary: The speaker cites Sean Dunston's Samsui Woman mural and Andrew Lacey's Raffles and Wallich statues as works that would benefit from labelling.

sentences.speaker: Ms Usha Chandradas (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Coming back to other examples of public art: we have Sean Dunston's Samsui Woman mural at South Bridge Road and the Raffles and Wallich statues at Fort Canning Park by Andrew Lacey.

sentences.speaker: Ms Usha Chandradas (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: These have both recently attracted a good deal of public attention; and I do think they would both benefit from insightful and comprehensive labelling.

sections.label: Contextualisation not erasure
sections.summary: The speaker says contextualising colonial times from different perspectives is not erasing historical facts or extreme woke-ness.

sentences.speaker: Ms Usha Chandradas (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: This does not equate to an erasure of historical facts, nor is it an example of extreme "woke-ness" which is blindly imported from the West.

sentences.speaker: Ms Usha Chandradas (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: It is simply a contextualisation of what was happening in colonial times from different perspectives.

sections.label: Comprehensive wall text for artworks
sections.summary: The speaker says comprehensive wall text like that in National Gallery Singapore or Singapore Art Museum would educate the public on issues raised by the artworks.

sentences.speaker: Ms Usha Chandradas (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: For both Dunston's and Lacey's works, comprehensive wall text, like what we might find in our National Gallery Singapore or Singapore Art Museum's excellent collections, would go a very long way towards educating the public on the complex and varied issues raised by these artworks.

sections.label: Better labelling for arts education
sections.summary: The speaker says images are open to multiple interpretations, labels guide understanding, and better labelling aids arts education and awareness.

sentences.speaker: Ms Usha Chandradas (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: This is an image that any student of art history will be able to tell Members, is open to multiple interpretations.

sentences.speaker: Ms Usha Chandradas (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: But without labels to guide understanding, the audience is lost.

sentences.speaker: Ms Usha Chandradas (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: To my mind, better labelling of artworks is a worthwhile endeavour in the quest to achieve better education and awareness of the art in our public spaces.

sentences.speaker: Ms Usha Chandradas (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: I hope the Government will continue its efforts to prioritise arts education in all forms, whether it is inside the classroom or outside of it.

sections.label: Arts education up to Secondary 2
sections.summary: All students up to Secondary 2 receive comprehensive arts education through MOE's centrally designed curriculum.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong)
sentences.text: All students up to Secondary 2, receive comprehensive arts education through MOE's centrally designed curriculum.

sections.label: University of the Arts Singapore
sections.summary: The University of the Arts Singapore, Singapore's first Government-supported private arts university, admits its first cohort this month.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong)
sentences.text: Furthermore, the University of the Arts Singapore, Singapore's first Government-supported private university of the arts, admits its first cohort this month.

sections.label: NAC Arts Education Programme access
sections.summary: Annually, 95% of MOE schools access the NAC Arts Education Programme, which offers over 1,000 artist-led arts education experiences.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong)
sentences.text: Annually, 95% of MOE schools access the NAC Arts Education Programme (NAC-AEP), which offers over 1,000 quality artist-led arts education experiences, complementing their arts learning in schools.

sections.label: PISA Creative Thinking ranking
sections.summary: In the 2022 PISA results, Singapore is the top-performing education system in Creative Thinking among 64 participating systems.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong)
sentences.text: According to the 2022 results of the Programme for International Student Assessment, also known as PISA, Singapore is the top-performing education system in Creative Thinking among 64 participating systems.

sections.label: Robert Zhao workshop for students
sections.summary: Mr Robert Zhao led a five-day workshop two years ago for pre-university Art students on the theme "Emergency".

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong)
sentences.text: Ms Chandradas referred to the works of artist Mr Robert Zhao.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong)
sentences.text: He led a five-day workshop two years ago for some of our pre-university Art students, during which participants discussed global concerns and created art in response to the theme "Emergency".

sections.label: Teacher performance assessment
sections.summary: Teachers are assessed based on how well they perform compared to other teachers, regardless of the subject they teach.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong)
sentences.text: Teachers are assessed based on how well they perform compared to other teachers, ensuring that their hard work and expertise are recognised and valued within the education system, regardless of the subject they teach.

sections.label: Art and Music Instructors Scheme
sections.summary: MOE's Art and Music Instructors Scheme provides grants for primary schools to hire arts instructors.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong)
sentences.text: MOE's Art and Music Instructors Scheme provides grants for primary schools to hire arts instructors.

sections.label: Public art labelling and teachers
sections.summary: Over 100 Art and Music teachers participate annually in showcases, and NAC commissions are attributed and labelled, with a 2022 labelling guide.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong)
sentences.text: Over 100 Art and Music teachers participates in these showcases annually.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
sentences.text: With regards to labelling of public art, we would like to inform Ms Chandradas that all works directly commissioned by NAC through the Public Art Trust will be and are appropriately attributed and labelled.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
sentences.text: In fact, in 2022, NAC released a Guide to Commissioning Public Art, which contains guidelines and best practices on labelling.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
sentences.text: Arts expand imagination, enhance creativity and develop adaptability, nurturing dispositions such as curiosity, openness and reflectiveness.
